packageRules.description: Group all GitHub Action updates into a single PR
Vendored sources land as committed trees in vendor/ and feed the agent harnesses — always review the diff
Orca releases several times a day but the vendored skills rarely change, so batch its bumps into one weekly PR

vendir.description: Tags in vendir.yml are tracked per source, so a whole-lockfile refresh would only re-open the all-at-once PR
